name: Banded Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust exercise performed with a resistance band loop placed across the hips instead of a barbell. The band provides increasing resistance toward the top of the movement where the glutes are most capable of producing force, making it a highly effective tool for glute activation and home training.

execution.starting_position: Sit with your upper back against a flat bench. Place a resistance band loop across your hips, anchored under both feet. Feet flat on the floor.
execution.setup_instructions: Sit on the floor with upper back on a bench. Thread a resistance band loop under both feet and over the hips.
steps: Step 1: Drive through both heels to thrust the hips upward.
Step 2: Extend the hips fully at the top, squeezing the glutes hard.
Step 3: Hold for a moment at the top.
Step 4: Lower the hips back toward the floor under control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the drive up. Inhale on the descent.
common_mistakes: Hyperextending the lumbar spine at the top
Not fully extending the hips at the top
safety_considerations: Chin stays tucked — do not hyperextend the neck at lockout
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full hip extension at the top — body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
